text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day. To attract a new audience to the races, a challenge project showcasing Gentildonna's immense power was held.
choice_data_list: The stage is set! If it's her, she'll surely—!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's starting! Our SNS live stream!
"The Gentlewoman's Ultimate Physical Challenge"!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Your challenge is the "Harrow Pull"!
Incredible! You'll be pulling 8 harrows
all at once with a wire!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone present here at the venue, and to all watching the stream:
Please savor a glimpse of my power."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—How many tons does a single harrow tractor weigh again...?
—Pulling eight of those is just straight-up impossible, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Creak... creak...!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna steps forward!
The rope around her waist pulls taut,
but the track harrow doesn't budge an inch!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
âSee, just as I thought...
âAs expected, there's just no way to pull this off...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...For an ordinary Umamusume,
such a challenge might be reckless.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yet, you...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
—From here on out, don't you dare blink, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Drag, drag... SKRRRRRR—T!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
I-It moved~~~~!!!!
Pulling the harrow cart, the noble lady strolls with leisurely ease!!
It's as if she's simply taking an elegant walk~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Seriously?! No way~~?!
—There's no way anyone could beat that...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: As expected... she's in a whole different league.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so! There's no way she can't be surpassed.
No, I will surpass her... in a race, without fail...!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: How are the reactions on social media looking?
choice_data_list: Everyone is amazed by your power.
Everyone is amazed by your power.

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Gentildonna is INSAAAANE!!"
"A race where such powerhouse runners clash..."
"I kind of want to see more of her in action!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Indeed. That is most satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Donna-oneesan, you're amazing, so amazing!
I want to race against you too!"

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
U-Um, wouldn't that be pretty tough?
She's in a league of her own, even among Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Why? If that lady is in a league of her own, then I just have to get even stronger than her!

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but... normally, nobody can do that.
Becoming that strong, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I wonder why you think so?

text_block_list.name: Father and Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Eh...!?
—Donna-oneesan!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Even when faced with a wall, looking beyond it and continuing to pursue greatness.
That is the true mark of the strong."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Young lady over there. Can you envision it?
A vision of you defeating me."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I can watch! Because, I mean!
If you don't wanna win, it's not a real match!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. You too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Then I admire your spirit. When the time is ripe, I shall gladly accept your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
I'm definitely going to race against you, big sis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. You are an impartial, steep wall
that looms tall before everyone."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yet, the one who will be the first to overcome that wall is me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And this time,
I will become your wall.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Using everything at my disposal—...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
That's one more thing to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna treats anyone seeking strength without prejudice. Word of her attitude spread, making her even more popular.
